pose: A tense, comedic near-miss scene. In the foreground, the larger feathered dinosaur is walking completely past the camera in a dynamic stride, looking off towards the distant forest with a determined, focused hunting expression. Right next to its massive stepping foot in the lower corner of the frame, the small juvenile sauropod lies entirely flat against the dirt path, frozen still. Thanks to its natural countershading and the dense surrounding fern foliage, it blends perfectly into the ground shadows, completely unnoticed by the hunter passing inches away.
